system.description: Closed Essence 14.3.8 - Magic Staff. Spells to create and progressively enchant a caster's own staff into an adder, a spell store, a guardian, a hammerstaff, or a beaststaff.

Allows the caster to take an appropriate material (e.g., wood, bone, metal, etc.) and form a staff. The caster must cast this spell once a day for 1 week (concentrating for 1 hour each day). At the end of this week, the caster has a minor staff. A minor staff is a +1 essence adder. If the staff is destroyed, then the caster immediately takes 50% of his hits and functions at -30 for 2 weeks.
The tip of the staff glows at whatever intensity the caster desires, from barest glimmer to a bright light (20'R). When the caster is not concentrating, the tip will only glow.

The caster can store any one spell in his staff. The spell to be stored must be cast immediately after this spell (within 1 minute). The power point cost of this spell is equal to the level of the store spell plus the cost of the spell to be stored. For example, in order to store a 5th level spell in a magic staff using Staff Spell I is equal to 5 (the level of the spell) + 3 (the cost of the store spell) = 8. The caster must spend power points to cast the spell that has been stored. A stored spell may be cast at any later time without preparation and does not prevent the caster from casting other spells normally. Every staff has up to 5 spell storage slots in it. Only the first of these slots is available through the use of this spell, so only one spell may be stored at a time through the use of Staff Spell I.
As Minor Staff, except that it turns the Minor Staff into a +1 adder and a +10 quarterstaff.

When this spell is cast on a staff, it becomes attuned to a particular situation. If this situation arises, the staff makes a sound, alerting the caster. The situation must be within 100' for the staff to register the alert. For example, if the caster attuned his staff to orcs, the staff would make a sound as soon as an orc registered within 100'. The caster must decide if he wants the alerting sound to be loud or soft at the time of casting.
This immediately returns the caster's staff to his outstretched hand if the staff is within range of this spell.

Caster may modify his magic staff so that it becomes attuned with a single spell list. It takes two hours of concentrating on the staff every day for one week in order to effect this transfer. During this transfer period the adder may only be used with the list to which it is being attuned. After this two week period, the staff receives an additional +1 adder once a staff is attuned to a list it may not be unattuned, though it could be attuned to a different list by the same process. If the staff is attuned to a different list during the attunement period, the adder may not be used for either list during the attunement period.
As Staff Spell I, except caster can store any one spell in the second spell storage slot in this slot and use it with no preparation at a later time.
As Lesser Staff, except that it turns the Lesser Staff into a +2 spell adder and a +10 quarterstaff.
As Recall Staff, except for range.
As Staff Spell I, except caster can store one spell in the third spell storage slot.

Caster's staff points in the direction of a specific object or place that he is familiar with or has described in detail. The caster must have the dimensions (within 10% of actual size) and know at least two other identifying attributes that make the item unique (e.g., color, texture, weight, etc.). Note that sometimes the caster must know more than two other attributes to make the item unique.
When this spell is cast, the caster adds his level to his Defensive Bonus and Resistance Rolls (e.g. a 15th level caster would add +15 to both his DB and all his RRs).
As Staff Spell I, except caster can store spells in the fourth spell storage slot.
As Greater Staff, except that it turns a Greater Staff into a +3 spell adder and a +15 quarterstaff.
Staff does double concussion hits for the duration of this spell.

Transforms caster's staff into any animal (creature intelligence). The creature's mass may not exceed 50 pounds. The beast is treated as a familiar (see Section 10.0 for more information on familiars).
As Staff Spell I, except caster can store spells in the fifth spell storage slot.
As Silver Staff, except that it turns a Silver into a +4 spell adder and a +15 quarterstaff. Alternatively, the caster may choose to change the staff into a x2 PP multiplier and a +10 quarterstaff.
Staff does triple concussion hits for the duration of this spell.
As Golden Staff, except that it turns a Golden into a +5 spell adder and a +20 quarterstaff. Alternatively, the caster may choose to change the staff into a x2 PP multiplier and a +15 quarterstaff.
As Lord Staff, except that it turns a Lord Staff into a +6 spell adder and a +30 quarterstaff. Alternatively, the caster may choose to change the staff into a x2 PP multiplier and a +20 quarterstaff.
